name: Chunky Name Sign
description: A word in a heavy display face, raised on a thick backing cut to the outline of the letters. WordArt-style shapes (arches, a round badge, wave, slant, bulge, pinch, perspective, stairs), horizontal or vertical layouts, an optional outer ring and letter outline in their own colours, a flat bottom or slotted foot to stand it on a shelf, and magnet pockets or keyhole slots in the back. The word shrinks to fit a maximum length. Two colours by default, up to four.
source: inspired by the MakerWorld Namensschild (name sign) customizer
